# First-run measure

Sessions run as described in [the first-run study](../studies/first-run-study.md): a participant new to Guardana, a clean environment, the published release and the README only.

**Not measured.** 0 of the 5 first-run sessions this adoption measure needs are recorded, so no completion rate or time is published. It is not a stable-release criterion.
